description: Share what you're carrying — fear, grief, doubt, gratitude, or a question you can't shake — and The Lonely Door searches 450 unique Bible translations (13.9 million verses, traced back to the original Hebrew, Greek, and Aramaic) to find the single most faithful scripture for your moment. Every response includes exegetical and historical context, an original-language word study with transliteration, inline citations so you can verify every claim, and a scripture-grounded prayer.

defaultPrompt: How can I do my part to make the world a better place?
